university.name: City University
university.status: UGC-approved private university under Private University Act 2010
university.campus: Permanent Campus at Khagan, Birulia, Savar, Dhaka-1340, Bangladesh
university.distance: Approximately 10 km from Gabtoli Inter-District Terminal

undergraduateEligibility.standard: Minimum GPA 2.50 in SSC and HSC separately, with total combined GPA 6.00
undergraduateEligibility.artsAndDesign: Minimum GPA 2.00 in SSC and HSC for Music, Fashion Design, Fine Arts, and Graphic Design
undergraduateEligibility.graduate: Undergraduate degree with at least 2.00 CGPA from UGC-approved university

waiverPolicy.specialQuotas: Up to 50% waiver for siblings, husband-wife, Quran Hafiz, freedom fighters' children/grandchildren, physically challenged students, and sports quota. Only highest waiver applies.

examRegulations.attendance: Mandatory 75% attendance in each registered course to be eligible for Midterm and Final examinations
examRegulations.documents: Valid Admit Card and physical Student ID Card required in exam hall
examRegulations.devices: Mobile phones, smart watches, and unauthorized electronic devices strictly prohibited
examRegulations.makeupWindow: Application with certified doctor / medical papers within 7 working days

committees.sexualHarassmentPrevention: Standing Sexual Harassment Prevention Committee formed 22 September 2026

transportNotice: Dedicated bus shuttles connect Gabtoli, Mirpur-10, Uttara, Dhanmondi, and Savar. Operating schedules shown on CampusOS are illustrative demo data for the hackathon.
